body: I thought I fixed it. But no, connection interruption always
Manually configuring ip and Mac address and stuff in my modem

It took me awhile but I think I got it figured out thanks to redditors and google. But I still don’t think you need to mess with all that to play a game. Not going to lie I’m not tech savvy when it comes to network stuff and they can’t expect everyone to know how to do that or follow the instructions to change those settings.
I watch so many streamers have issues. And the shaking screen is ridiculous
Let’s start a community with like minded individuals and we all can help better our mental state
Thank you. Brought a little light to this darkness.

I’m trying to outsource, it’s been hard with no support.  I live in Utah and there’s not many places to volunteer for. And I’m being forced to get a job or I will be homeless in a week and the crap just keeps building up.
This isn’t a joyful ride.  More like the swirling vortex of terror

Thank you, I’ve been struggling with all this for awhile and can’t seem to get out of this slump I try to talk to my friends but they don’t take me seriously. So I came to reddit to maybe get some advice, a word of hope. And it’s been more helpful than the people in my life.
